_readme: Every key is optional (a missing key = the default described in README 'Configuration'). kit.ps1 setup -WriteLocal writes skills/dev-kit/kit.local.json from this file (minus localFiles) and each localFiles entry to its path; all of them are git-ignored. Fill the <...> values. Paths: forward slashes work on every OS.
trackerLists: <tracker container whose promoted tasks deploy intest checks: list id / owner/repo / project key>

tracker._readme: type: none (default) | clickup | github | gitlab | jira. statuses maps the logical statuses to your board's names (a list = the first is set, all match). Examples for each backend: _examples.
tracker.list: <default list id / Jira project key for new tasks>
tracker.owner: <optional: assignee of new tasks; empty = your OS full name matched to a tracker member>
tracker.branchTag: <tag before the task id in branches and MR titles, e.g. CU- / GH- / PROJ- ; default from type>

reports._readme: type: gdocs (Google Docs + Drive via gws; default when gws is installed) | markdown (files in the run folder, carried by the tracker comment)

driveParent: <Google Drive folder or shared-drive id for testing docs and reports (reports.type gdocs)>

qa._readme: outOfScope: channels agent QA never tests (their steps are OUT_OF_SCOPE: reported, never counted). targets: target groups for /test-and-close select runs (target: '<group>'): per task the first rule whose lists / repos / nameRegex / pathRegex match gives its env (localEnv: a local env, live = in its running release).
outOfScope: <a channel agent QA never tests, e.g. a chat app, email delivery, an error tracker>

deploy._readme: trigger: owner (default: nobody asks or proposes a deploy; a person says deploy <env> and the coordinator deploys at once) or ask (one batched ask per env, at most one per minIntervalHours: a number, or per target with a default). planTimeoutSec bounds orch.ps1 deploy plan.

net._readme: timeoutSec per git-host / tracker CLI call; transient errors retry, lost tracker writes wait in .state/outbox.jsonl (supervise replays them)

tests._readme: Per stack (dev.ps1 stack names): the test names -Touched looks for, from a changed source file's base name ({name}). Defaults: maven/gradle {name}Test, {name}Tests, {name}IT; dotnet {name}Tests, {name}Test; python test_{name}, {name}_test; go {name}_test; web {name}.spec, {name}.test.

localEnv._readme: Local envs (local-env skill): the dev flow tests every change here before merge. Any shape: a service is a start command in a folder. Secrets: <kit>/.state/localenv/<env>.env (dotenv), never here.

db.clone: <script: a DB server on {+5432} with a copy of the test data>

memory._readme: keepDefault: false = Claude Code auto memory lives in <kit>/memory/ (git-ignored); true = keep the user's own setting.

kitAudit._readme: everyDays: the SessionStart nudge asks for a kit-auditor run when the last audit is older (default 7; 0 = off).

build._readme: mavenOffline: Maven runs with -o when ~/.m2/repository exists (default true).

gate._readme: Memory gate. keepFreeGB (default 15% of RAM, min 6) = RAM every build leaves free; startHeapGB = first heap for a project with no history; heapMinGB = the floor.

repos.name: web
repos.linkFrom: <a checkout whose node_modules can be linked (optional)>

deploys.target: <env deployed by hand onto a host>
<env deployed by hand, no way to check>

linkFromByTarget.<other target branch>: <a checkout of that branch with its own install>

linkPaths: <git-ignored file or folder every worktree needs, e.g. local credentials or local.properties>

bugfixMandate: <the owner's own words asking the coordinator to fix QA-raised bugs, verbatim>

skills/qa-kit/targets.local.json._readme: One entry per TEST environment (never production), the local env included. Passwords live ONLY here. users: <key for qa.ps1 api -As / browser.mjs as> -> [login, password].

skills/android-swarm/swarm.config.json._readme: Lanes = AVD names (swarm.ps1 avd create). Each lane has its own test login ('user', a key in targets.local.json) and 'notes'. localManifests: the app's own manifests that allow cleartext (debug variants), merged into the release build by swarm.ps1 build -Local; localReverse: ports acquire -Apk local reverses to this machine (the local API).
